description: Implement the Services section (6 glass cards in responsive grid with hover-lift and glow), Process/How It Works section (timeline with animated connecting line that draws on scroll), and Portfolio/Work Showcase section (masonry/grid of project thumbnails in glass frames with 3D tilt on hover).
steps: Implement src/components/Services.tsx: Section heading with gradient accent. Responsive grid (3 columns desktop, 2 tablet, 1 mobile) of 6 glassy cards (backdrop-blur, semi-transparent bg, thin translucent border, rounded-3xl). Each card has: icon (from react-icons), title, short description. On hover: lift up (translateY), glow shadow expansion, border brightens. Cards animate in on scroll with stagger using Framer Motion. The 6 services are: Web Development, Mobile App Development, Graphic Design, Motion Graphics, AI Content Creation, Content Provider Outreach/Hooking.

Implement src/components/Process.tsx: Section heading. Horizontal timeline on desktop, vertical on mobile showing 4 steps: Discover, Design, Develop, Deliver. Each step has an icon, title, and brief description in a glass card. An animated SVG line connects the steps and draws in on scroll (using Framer Motion pathLength animation triggered by useInView). Steps fade in sequentially.

Implement src/components/Portfolio.tsx: Section heading. Grid of 6 project thumbnails (use placeholder gradient backgrounds with project names). Each item in a rounded glass frame. On hover: reveal project name + tags overlay with a slight 3D tilt effect (rotateX/rotateY based on mouse position using onMouseMove handler). Responsive layout (3 columns desktop, 2 tablet, 1 mobile).
acceptance_criteria: Services section displays 6 cards in responsive grid with all specified services
Cards have glassmorphism styling with hover effects (lift, glow)
Process section shows 4-step timeline with animated connecting line
Portfolio section shows project grid with hover overlay and 3D tilt
